requirements.id: mcp.troubleshooting.Server is configured but never connects
requirements.note: §8.3 item 1 now points to the new §8.3.1, which states every MCP validator message of the 2.1.321 corpus with its fixed wording, severity and finding path (unknown type, url without type, non-object server config, schema type errors with the 'silently drops this server' tail, missing MCP servers file, non-regular or oversized file). Evidence: oracle 2.1.321, corpus (validator-messages.md); got number/boolean/null and the size-cap wording from oracle 2.1.325 (J8.27).

§8.5 item 5 had no marker (spec-fixes); it now carries this id, sourced from errors.md, "MCP server name is reserved", and gives the documented fix (rename where defined). The plugin-key exception stays Judgment J8.12.

requirements.id: mcp.behavior.Mark tools that are safe to call twice
requirements.note: §8.10.2 now states what a pending call that is not repeated returns to Claude (errors.md, "MCP server connection closed before the tool call was answered", docs: marker).

judgments.note: New: how a stdio server's command line is quoted under CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX (§8.2.1); env-vars.md gives the single shell-quoted $1, not per-element quoting.
New: the validator's <kind> values and the size-cap wording for MCP server files; oracle 2.1.325 on own minimal inputs beside the 2.1.321 corpus.
New: a plugin server's resources go under its scoped name, as its prompts (J8.12).
New: the LSP requests behind the seven operations of tools-reference.md, "LSP tool behavior" (§9.1.4 item 5).

Severity stated: a broken plugin settings.json or a dropped key is a load warning, never a plugin failure, and the validator reports nothing. Added the oracle 2.1.321 corpus evidence (no finding on kindex, claude-crew, claude-music, just-ship; each loads).

The allowManagedHooksOnly case is now documented (statusline.md, "Subagent status lines": plugin values never run under it, even force-enabled) and stated with a docs: marker; the judgment keeps only the disableAllHooks-outside-managed and --safe-mode cases.
New: the run and failure rules of the subagentStatusLine command, taken from statusLine (§12.6.1).
